title: Wire main_app.dart to use AppTheme
description: Update lib/main_app.dart to consume the new `AppTheme` instead of the legacy `BlocoNaRuaTheme`. Surgical diff only — preserve EVERYTHING else (BlocProvider<AuthCubit> create, MaterialApp.router, routerConfig, localizationsDelegates, supportedLocales, themeMode: ThemeMode.system, title). Step 1: change import `package:bloco_na_rua/ui/core/theme/bloco_na_rua_theme.dart` to `package:bloco_na_rua/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart`. Step 2: change `theme: BlocoNaRuaTheme.lightTheme` to `theme: AppTheme.light()`. Step 3: change `darkTheme: BlocoNaRuaTheme.darkTheme` to `darkTheme: AppTheme.dark()`. Do NOT touch any other line — specifically do not delete the old theme import on disk yet (that's a separate Phase 5c cleanup subtask). Do NOT touch pubspec.yaml, the router, or any cubit. Do NOT add new dependencies. Re-run `flutter analyze lib/main_app.dart` to confirm 0 errors. Briefly run `flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64` IF possible (otherwise note that only analyze was validated).
